title: Distribution Network for IP

Distribution Network for IPC Priced Publication


IPC Priced Publications & subscription of IP Online portal are available for sale from IPC Secretariat and its distributors as follows:

IPC Secretariat:

The priced Publications can be procured from the office of the Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Sector 23, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad 201 002 (UP) by paying through Demand Draft of required amount issued in favour of "Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission" payable at Ghaziabad.
